Bill.BriefDescription: Providing the utilities and transportation commission with guidelines when reviewing service extension requests.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to review by the commission of service extensionrequests; and adding a new section to chapter 80.36 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 80.36 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) Upon receiving a written complaint from an individual who hasbeen denied a petition for service extension by a telecommunicationscompany, the commission must conduct an investigation. The commissionmust investigate the complaint and issue a written decision withinninety days. In investigating a complaint, the commission mustconsider: (a) The total direct cost of the extension; (b) The number of customers served; (c) The comparative price and capabilities of radio communicationservice or other alternatives available to customers; (d) Technological difficulties and physical barriers presented bythe requested extensions; (e) The likelihood that other neighboring customers may requestservice if the service extension is granted; p. 1 HB 3151 (f) The effect on the individuals and communities involved; (g) The effect on the public switched network; and (h) The effect on the company. (2) When reviewing a request for service extension, the commissionmust make every effort to keep the petitioner informed and make thepetition process as straightforward as possible.
